index_courses
=============

.. py:module:: index_courses


Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   index_courses.index_collections
   index_courses.index_collection


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: index_collections()

   Generate and store embeddings for all courses and requirements in the database.
   This should be run once to initialize the vector database.


.. py:function:: index_collection(collection, collection_type)

   Generate and store embeddings for all documents in a collection.

   :param collection: MongoDB collection object
   :param collection_type: String identifier for the collection ('courses' or 'requirements')
